title: Unsafe YAML deserialization via yaml.load() — review required
description: yaml.load() without an explicit SafeLoader can construct arbitrary Python objects from untrusted YAML, which is remote code execution when the document is attacker-influenced. This lexical rule flags every yaml.load( call; the Loader argument needs human review.
remediation: Use yaml.safe_load() for untrusted documents. If full YAML is required, pass Loader=yaml.SafeLoader explicitly and never load documents from untrusted senders.
limitation: Lexical: flags all yaml.load( calls even when a safe Loader is passed on the same line; yaml.safe_load( never matches. Loader-argument dataflow is out of scope.
